notes.title: Happy Halloween !
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
To celebrate Halloween, I've released a new game update. Around 30 images have been reworked to enhance the visual experience, a dedicated gallery has been added, and the option to rewind the timeline has been disabled, making timed choices even more strategic and engaging. The homepage has also been optimized. Lastly, to make the game more accessible to an international audience, it now defaults to English at startup.

[i]Thank you for your support, and Happy Halloween to all! 🎃[/i]

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone[/b],

We are pleased to announce the new update of Killer Night! In this version, we have introduced some graphical improvements and an addition to the ending that makes the overall gameplay even more complete and immersive.

We have also revised parts of the code and fixed the Italian and English localizations, as well as added support for the Russian language.

If you encounter any issues, we recommend reinstalling the game. Should any bugs or persistent problems related to the code or translations arise, feel free to report them on the forum. It will be my priority to address your feedback and resolve any issues.

[i]Thank you for your continued support![/i]

notes.title: Official Release of "Killer Night"
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to announce the official release of "Killer Night," a gripping psychological thriller that promises to keep players glued to their screens until the very end.

[b]Game Synopsis:[/b]

"Killer Night" plunges players into an immersive experience within a dark, secret-filled mansion. Broadcasted on Channel 8, a group of participants finds themselves trapped in a mysterious survival game. Their only hope? Uncovering the identity of the hidden killer among them before it's too late. With multiple endings based on player choices, "Killer Night" offers a suspense-filled experience with unexpected twists and challenging moral decisions.
[b]
Key Features:[/b]

[i]An Engaging Psychological Plot:[/i] Uncover dark secrets and navigate the tension of a deadly survival game.

[i]Deeply Developed Characters:[/i] Interact with complex characters, each with their own dark past and hidden motives.

[i]Multiple Endings:[/i] Your choices will determine who survives and what fate awaits the participants.

[i]Immersive Atmosphere:[/i] A setting that keeps you constantly on edge, with unsettling sounds and dim lighting.

[b]Developer's Statement:[/b]

"I'm incredibly proud to finally share 'Killer Night' with the world. My goal was to create an experience that combines the best of psychological thrillers with interactive storytelling filled with twists and turns. I can't wait to see how players navigate the moral choices and uncover the hidden secrets within the mansion."
